User: I think first, the freshness. You can taste that nothing's been sitting around. The lettuce is always crisp. The tomato actually tastes like a tomato. And the burger comes off the grill nice and hot. I think second, you have the balance, the meat, the cheese, the sauce, the bun, and nothing's really overpowering anything else. It all works together. I think it's rich, but it's not really heavy. And third, you've got consistency. There's no matter which location you're at, you always know exactly what you're getting. That reliability, I think to me, builds trust and that matters to me the most.
Agent: Those are excellent points about freshness, balance, and consistency. It's clear why those elements are so important to you.

Now, on the flip side, what are the top two or three things that would make your In-N-Out Double Double "bad" for you?
